events.text:
Rewritten. The one body line had three violations:

| Original | Issue | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "Leverage" | forbidden term (major) | "Use" — the preferred term |
| "cutting-edge" | forbidden term (major) | dropped; it's a marketing superlative with no factual content |
| "our workspace" | `person_pov: second` — voice addresses the reader, not the vendor | imperative "Use the Northwind workspace" (implicit *you*) |

Result: `Use the Northwind workspace.` — plain, direct, active voice, short, neutral tone.

One thing worth flagging: the source line carried no actual information about what Northwind does, so a faithful rewrite is necessarily thin. I didn't invent capabilities to pad it. If you can tell me what the workspace is for, I can write a compliant sentence that says something.
